objective: Kill Lieutenant Fangore and return to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire with his paw.

description: Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
progress: What news do you bring before the Court?
completion: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, <class>. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
